mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns as corporate earnings face downward pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of corporate revenue slowdowns and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS change < -1.0% and HOUST change < -2.0% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 1.0% and HOUST declines > 2.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (as indicated by high prior-quarter GDP growth), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending manufacturing slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% in prior quarter)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and GDPC1 growth > 2.0% in prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 5-year moving average indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 155,000 signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy heads into recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 155000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a monetary policy response to a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines > 0.5pp and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
regime_hint: monetary easing amid labor market deterioration
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines > 0.5pp and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation environments (CPIAUCSL change > 3.5% in 1 month), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflationary risks, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL change > 3.5% in 1 month.
